{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The process is very experimental. We haven't gotten past a few problems with ''abnormal'' brain development yet.|[[Unidentified cloning technician 2|Unidentified cloning technician]]|<ref name="TFUIIc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>}}
A '''memory flash,''' also known as '''memory imprint,''' was a form of psychological conditioning that affected the mental and emotional status of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]. The process of creating memory flashes included the scanning of the [[Clone template/Legends|original subject's]] brain patterns, which would then be downloaded into the clone's mind. Although this procedure provided the clone with the knowledge and experience of its progenitor, the side effects of inheriting the memories of another person's life were instability and ultimately [[Clone madness|insanity]].

==History==
{{Quote|I sometimes smell a forest on fire. I see the General falling, and I feel the ground shake as a starship crashes around me. I hear a woman's voice when I try to sleep.''"<br />"''They are the memories of a dead man. A side effect of the cloning process and the memory flashes used to train you. They will fade.|Starkiller and Darth Vader, regarding memory imprints|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
After [[Galen Marek]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] endeavored to recreate his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] by utilizing the [[Timira City]] Cloning Facility of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TFUII" /> An altered version of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] method resulted in the creation of "accelerated clones," thereby producing fully grown subjects in a matter of weeks rather than years.<ref name="TFUIIc" /> Utilizing Marek's preserved corpse as a [[Clone template/Legends|source]] of [[DNA/Legends|genetic material]], Vader successfully duplicated the pseudo-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-turned-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], only to discover that the procedure was flawed and the subjects unstable.<ref name="DT">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'': "Distant Thunder" cutscenes</ref>

Aside from the inherent difficulty of cloning a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] template, the use of memory flashes undermined the psychological well-being of various clones. Vader wanted the new Starkiller to possess the original apprentice's skills; where Marek learned how to utilize his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] after years of [[Sith training|training]], the same knowledge could simply be downloaded into his clone via memory flashes. But due to the fact that the clone also inherited the memories of a life that it never actually experienced, the subject ultimately succumbed to [[Clone madness|mental instability]]. As a result, Vader repeated the procedure numerous times, passing over one failure after another in the hope that a stable clone would finally be created once the cloning process was perfected.<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

After [[1 BBY/Legends|six months]] of trial and error, Darth Vader secretly possessed many [[aberrant clone]]s of Galen Marek, including a [[Subject 1138|more stable version]] whose progress attracted the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] notice. Vader hoped that the project had at last made its first successful attempt to recreate Starkiller, but the latest clone proved unable to overcome certain memory and emotional imprints inherited from his genetic donor, much like other test subjects who failed to pass their trials before him. Realizing that the clone possessed Marek's emotional attachment to [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], Vader deemed him yet another failure in a long line of disappointments. Before the clone could be terminated however, he managed to [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escape]] his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] in order to find Eclipse.<ref name="TFUII" />

Around the same time, Darth Vader also oversaw the development of another [[Dark Apprentice|Starkiller clone]], one of who proved even more promising than all of his precursors. While he too was initially confused by the memory imprints, the clone was driven by a desire to succeed where the others had failed. He strove to prove himself in Vader's eyes so that no more versions would come after him and after many trials, the Sith Lord claimed the dark clone as his new secret apprentice.<ref name="DT" /> Ultimately, it was the clone's ability to compartmentalize the memory flashes that contributed to his success. By separating Marek's memories from his own experiences, the Dark Apprentice freed himself from his template's emotional attachments, thus preventing him from becoming another clone controlled by the imprinted identity of Galen Marek.<ref name="Databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in-game databank</ref>

A [[Unidentified cloning technician|cloning technician]] worked with another of Galen Marek's clone, [[Subject 1157]]. 1157 received memory imprints as well, and the resulting [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] caused 1157's body to tremble and also worsened his temperament. The cloning technician tried sedating 1157 to control the tremblings as the memory flashes were imprinted.<ref name="Website">{{LucasArts|url=games/theforceunleashed2|text=''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II''}}</ref>

In addition to Marek's clones, Darth Vader also ordered the creation of accelerated clones of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], but without the cloned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] knowledge. [[Xasha]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and Fett's occasional partner, provided Vader's cloning technicians with Fett's genetic material and the scanned brain patterns that would be used to develop memory flashes. But the Fett clones were unstable, just like the Starkiller batch. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who oversaw Fett's clones concluded that the subjects would be fit for service as [[clone stormtrooper]]s for a short while before their minds completely degraded into insanity.<ref name="TFUIIc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Memory flashes, or memory imprints, were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|comic adaptation]] of [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' multi-media project. Subject 1157, who received memory flashes from Starkiller, was an ambiguously [[canon]] character in ''The Force Unleashed II'' Official Website in the lead-in to the release of ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II.''<ref name="Website" />
